scope: Three runs per APK, 180 update batches per phase. Dispatch wait excludes SoundPool call/device output latency.

execution.rateUnits: [vanilla, custom] requests per update; burst = 48 custom requests every 30 updates
execution.method: Median of three per-run means and per-run percentiles; main runs without profiling wrappers. Diagnostics separate.
execution.nativeLogCountsScope: Occurrences across each full session, including warmup and functional checks; not per-request failures.
execution.excluded: V1 measurements and invalid HOME-only pause attempts. Lifecycle-fixed preflight is not counted.

restoration.completed: Preferences matched byte for byte; all original saves matched SHA-256. Temporary mod and save copies removed.

limitations: Native backend saturation remains; AudioTrack creation errors in both variants.
A positive native play return is not proof of physical audio output.
Estimated stream completion uses duration and pitch.
Queue wait excludes backend play duration and device output latency.
Independent median counters can cross phase boundaries; do not sum them as one run.
Moderate diagnostic is one A/B pair with wrappers, four requests/update and native failures in both variants.
No physical-device audio capture or real Split boss fight validation.
